claim_boundary: This record freezes a future conditioning comparison. It is not Phase-B execution, independent confirmation, WAM qualification, or ranking evidence.

primary_closed_loop.reason: Injecting recorded future observations after rollout start would teacher-force the system, hide compounding error, and cease to test closed-loop WAM behavior.
primary_closed_loop.policy_history: If an upstream frozen policy requires an observation history, use its exact documented history contract. After the initial boundary, populate advancing history with WAM-predicted observations only; do not invent a history length or leak recorded futures.
primary_closed_loop.wam_history: Use the exact native WAM contract independently for each arm; do not give one arm extra temporal evidence unless that difference is the explicitly registered variable.

teacher_forced_prefix_diagnostic.purpose: Measure whether a short real motion prefix improves continuation stability and isolate cold-start ambiguity from rollout drift.
